versions.changelog: Update API key setup and request routing

- Shifted credential storage to a local api_key file in the skill directory; environment variables and other global paths are no longer used.
- Users are now prompted to confirm before creating or replacing the skill-local api_key file, and must confirm uploads or sensitive operations unless already authorized.
- Integration routing parameter sourceType=5 is now included in request details when users request them, for greater transparency.
- Added .clawhubignore for private/runtime files; removed obsolete sync script and skill card documentation.
- The SKILL.md clarifies credential handling and instructs to exclude the local api_key from version control and publishing.

- Added workflow step to include the internal routing parameter sourceType in all ComPDF API requests (not to be exposed in user-facing outputs).
- Removed the sample file skill-card.md.
- No changes to supported operations or API usage instructions.

- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Updated the user referral URL for obtaining an API key to use "clawhub" parameters.

- Initial release of compdf-pdf-to-json skill.
- Converts PDF content—including text, tables, images, and structured data—into machine-readable JSON.
- Provides workflow guidance for selecting and using the official ComPDF Server API endpoint.
- Ensures secure API key handling from local files only.
- Designed to facilitate integration with AI pipelines, automation platforms, or system applications needing structured PDF extraction.
